subject: Re: MAP - Environment gating & credential checklist for POC
messages:
From: Emma Walsh <emma@novacare.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: purchasing@procurecorp.com
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC gating questions + MAP kickoff

Marcus —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We want to map out the POC gating items so our security and procurement teams can sign off quickly. Two immediate asks from our side:

1) A minimal checklist for environment access (API keys, org invite, service account vs ephemeral keys).
2) A small CSV template for the IP allowlist and a note on VPC peering prerequisites (peerable regions, shared VPC restrictions).

Procurement (CC) will need an initial SOW/price snapshot to start internal approvals. Can you share the MAP with timing (we're targeting a 4-week evaluation starting Jan 5)?

Thanks —
Emma Walsh
Head of Partnerships, NovaCare
emma@novacare.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Walsh <emma@novacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, purchasing@procurecorp.com
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC gating questions + MAP kickoff

Emma — great to connect. I pulled together a short MAP snapshot and attached two starter artifacts: a network allowlist CSV and a redlineable SOW draft. Key notes below, summary timeline at the bottom.

Quick answers:
- API keys: We'll provision an org-level service account for the POC with scoped API keys. For short-lived test tokens we can enable ephemeral tokens for your devs (recommended for developers not needing long-term keys).
- Org invite: Send me the admin email for your POC org and we'll invite a group role ("NovaCare POC Admins").
- IP allowlist: Use the attached template. We'll accept a CIDR list and specific public IPs; if you prefer VPC peering we require a public egress IP range or dedicated peering subnet.
- VPC peering: Supported in us-west-2 and us-east-1 for the Dedicated trial. Peering requires your VPC CIDR, a proposed BGP ASN if using managed routing, and a maintenance window for the initial handshake (usually 1 hour).

Attach: novacare-sow-draft-v1.pdf; network-allowlist-template.csv

Proposed MAP + close timeline (high-level):
Week 0 (Jan 5 start): Org invite, API key issuance, allowlist submission
Week 1: Traffic smoke tests, sample inference calls, latency snapshot
Week 2: Load run and perf profile; iterate batch sizing & KV cache hints
Week 3: Security/compliance checklist sign-off, procurement SOW review
Week 4: Final acceptance and runway for decision

If you want, Ben can lead the network handoff and Neha will coordinate SOC2/data handling artifacts.

Next step: Emma — can you share the admin emails and the IP list by Wed 12/10? Procurement can review the SOW in parallel.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Walsh <emma@novacare.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, purchasing@procurecorp.com
Date: Tue, 09 Dec 2025 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC gating questions + MAP kickoff

Emma — quick network checklist from our infra team (short list):

1) Provide the public egress IPs for your staging/VPN jumpboxes (we'll add to allowlist).
2) Confirm if you want: simple IP allowlist OR VPC peering. If peering: provide VPC ID, region, and intended CIDR.
3) If using peering, please designate a technical contact for routing and a preferred maintenance window.

Notes on peering constraints: we do not accept overlapping CIDRs. Cross-account peering requires your cloud admin to open a peering connection request; our side will accept it and coordinate route-table updates. We recommend an initial small window (15–30 minutes) and a follow-up validation run.

I'll schedule a 30m handoff call Thu 12/11 at 10:00 PT to walk the team through the peering steps — does that work?

Attaching: quick_peering_steps.txt (stub)

—Ben

Thanks — that's helpful. Procurement looped in and asked for a short SOW + price snapshot (they received the draft). Our security lead (cc'd offline) prefers ephemeral keys for all non-admin users.

We've uploaded a partial IP list and the admin email (admin+pods@novacare.com) to the shared doc link: https://docsend.com/s/novacare_map_v1 — please confirm when the org invite and initial API key are ready.

We can take the 12/11 10:00 PT slot for the peering call — Emma + our cloud engineer (mike@novacare.com) will join. Looking forward to the handshake.

Best,
Emma
